query: SELECT tax_year, COUNT(*)::int AS n, COUNT(year_built)::int AS yb, COUNT(land_acres)::int AS la FROM cad_property WHERE county_fips = '48491' GROUP BY tax_year ORDER BY tax_year
queryNote: Live GROUP BY returned 2026 only. Leftover 2025 filed as n=0 (absent year, not a fabricated store row).
